annotations.title: List a post's video edit revisions

description: A post's video edit revisions, newest first: each save's rev, when, who and what changed. To go back to the list from before a revision, call undo with its activity_id (within 7 days): the older list comes back as a new rev, and that can be undone too. Hook versions for trial reels (another opening line or shot) are the list's versions, set with edit_set.
name: edit_versions
